Title: View change data through Azure Monitor workbook integration with Application Change Analysis

Body.Content:
DevOps engineers may need to monitor hundreds and even thousands of Azure resources every day. Rich visualizations and analysis are essential to tell who changed what at one glance for managing large number of resources at scale. The recently released integration between Azure Monitor workbook and Application Change Analysis allows you to create various types of charts using change data as a data source. For example, you can create a time-series chart to view when important changes happened in the past 24 hours or leveraging the merge capability to see what changed before a spike in VM memory. We published a change analysis workbook template for Azure Storage resources as a getting started experiment, but Change Analysis is available as a workbook data source for all resource types. If you have questions or feedback email changeanalysishelp@microsoft.com.

Learn more.
